title: Forge effect cleanup v1 (an additive payload extension at event_schema 1)
description: The optional, absent-by-default payload fields the proposed #403 addendum to decision 0006 adds to effect/indeterminate: an attempt whose process tree is not proven over parks, whatever its driver reached, and its event keeps the outcome received beside the unresolved cleanup. Legal at event_schema 1 under the amended rule in contracts/README.md: optional, absent by default, published here as a numbered extension schema, and never read by fold — the reason already carries the indeterminate outcome, and RunState gains nothing from these fields. An attempt proven over journals byte-identical payloads.

received.description: Present, with cleanup, when a single seat or a sequence's single or dialect step is not proven over: the outcome its driver reached, as it reached it. A checkpoint the journal refused changes the outcome acted on, which the reason names, never this one.

cleanup.description: Present, with received: why the attempt's end could not be certified.

unresolved_members.description: Present when a panel parks because members of it are not proven over: each such member's evidence, keyed by the member's name. A member proven over is absent. Its own checkpoint marker is a closed seat record and carries none.

reason.description: In the operator's words: a group or a descendant still running, a stray that could not be attributed, a refused kill, an unreaped leader, a missing means, a table that could not be read, or a pipe held outside the tree.
